Finding: SQLite/file-descriptor leak
Resolution: Explicit closing SQLite connection classes, serialized initialization, and resource regression coverage. Full one-process suite ended with 0 SQLite descriptors.

Finding: Duplicate same-folder Import race
Resolution: Canonical-folder active-job uniqueness, existing-job reuse, idempotent Commit, and unique per-job staging.

Finding: Launcher could start obsolete source
Resolution: Pinned launcher and user service are rewritten by installer; status prints project, venv executable, data path, PID, version, and schema.

Finding: Batch Editor rendered all items
Resolution: Bounded server-side paging with 20–200 rows; 5,000-item page rendered 100 rows and 430,721 bytes.

Finding: Fill Down unsupported for Tags
Resolution: Atomic exact set/replace of validated Tag IDs with auditing.

Finding: Location Fill Down used stale shelf key
Resolution: Location mapping, nullable None handling, arbitrary free text, and location-history events.

Finding: Fill Down unsupported for Review/Rare
Resolution: Atomic exact boolean propagation in both directions.

Finding: Horizontal navigation stuck at Tags
Resolution: ArrowLeft/ArrowRight use the tag input focus path.

Finding: Hidden selected rows remained armed
Resolution: Selections are cleared as rows become hidden; bulk actions only read visible selected rows.

Finding: Shelf-only wording
Resolution: Current UI and guides use location/unassigned terminology.

Finding: Individual Rare edit silently discarded
Resolution: rare added to the editable-field contract with regression coverage.

Finding: Publish page dry-ran every item
Resolution: Publish summary uses aggregate SQL; dry-run is opt-in and bounded to the current page.

Finding: Doctor falsely failed in an active external venv
Resolution: Doctor accepts either the project venv or an active Python virtual environment.

Finding: CSRF URL resolution depended on window location
Resolution: Same-origin checks resolve against document.baseURI, preserving reverse-proxy and verification behavior.

Finding: Modern Dev Dashboard apps did not expose the static token required by Settings
Resolution: Added Client ID/Client Secret configuration and automatic client-credentials token exchange.

Finding: Short-lived Shopify tokens required daily manual replacement
Resolution: Added encrypted restart-safe cache, proactive refresh, and one bounded 401 refresh/retry.

Finding: Shopify secrets and generated tokens needed stronger at-rest handling
Resolution: Added Fernet-encrypted secret and token stores with owner-only permissions and plaintext migration.

Finding: Duplicate token fields and raw Location GID entry made Settings confusing
Resolution: Replaced duplicate forms with one guided workflow and named location selection.

Finding: Missing scopes and authentication failures were not clearly distinguished
Resolution: Added authoritative minimum-scope declaration and actionable diagnostics.

Finding: Concurrent requests could create a token-refresh storm
Resolution: Added thread/filesystem locks and cache re-check after lock acquisition.

Finding: Credential replacement or removal could leave stale cached access
Resolution: Credential fingerprint invalidation and authenticated removal clear generated tokens safely.

Finding: Existing static tokens required a safe transition path
Resolution: Preserved deprecated legacy fallback until operator verification and removal.

Finding: Publish workflow stopped after simulation and never called ShopifyService.upload_draft
Resolution: Added durable create-drafts endpoint, job runner, progress UI, persisted Shopify IDs, and restart recovery.

Finding: No safe batch live-publish action existed
Resolution: Added draft-first live publication using selected Shopify publication and exact SUBMIT confirmation.

Finding: No deliberate direct-live override existed
Resolution: Added explicit direct-live path requiring exact SUBMIT LIVE confirmation; draft-first remains default.

Finding: Shopify work could duplicate after refresh or restart
Resolution: Added schema-16 durable jobs/per-item stages, completed-item skipping, SKU/GID reconciliation, and bounded retry.

Finding: No Shopify product lifecycle management in SnapIMS
Resolution: Added selected/batch sync, reconcile, archive, restore draft, irreversible delete, keep-Shopify, and merge actions with typed confirmations.

Finding: No publication selection for live storefront placement
Resolution: Added publication discovery/selection and required read_publications/write_publications capability validation.

Finding: No durable progress or actionable per-item results
Resolution: Added progress, elapsed time, ETA, status rows, retries, failures, links, and GID copy controls.

Finding: No batch lifecycle controls on Publish
Resolution: Added rename, duplicate, archive, restore, export, import/CSV, history, and guarded batch management controls.

Finding: CLI and browser could resolve different Shopify configuration contexts
Resolution: Aligned CLI project/data resolution and added snapims shopify status/test/refresh/jobs commands.
